first.text: Well look who it is!
A lost soul, fallen through the veil. Cast into the world of manifested thought...

first.name: Hubert
first.text: Where am I?
You are elsewhere, nowhere, up above and down below. You are not home, no, you are not indeed.
My name is Gaviota, and-

first.name: Hubert
first.text: Oh my god...

first.name: Hubert
first.text: I've been spirited away, haven't I?
You’ve been cast into- uh… yes. Yes you have.
And to get back home, you have to-

first.name: Hubert
first.text: Uuuuughhhh maan I gotta call my boss…

first.name: Hubert
first.text: How am I gonna tell him I’m in one of those damn “complete these challenges three” situations again…
Wait, how did you-

first.name: Hubert
first.text: This is the third time this month I get kidnapped by you gnome bastards trying to magic spell my ass into psychology!
We’re not gnomes, we’re elves…

first.name: Hubert
first.text: My boss is gonna kill me. I gotta get back.
Well, to do that you have to complete the three… challenges.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: There’s no phone service here.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: ugh…

first.name: Hubert
first.text: I swear. You gnomes are gonna be the death of me.
Elves-

first.name: Hubert
first.text: I'll punch you.
No no no. In this world, a forceful approach will not get you far.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: How very magical of you...
Yes indeed. You cannot defeat your foes with violence here.
You're in the world of spirits now.
Yes, force does very little to dim one’s spirit. Very little, indeed.
To prevail you must use your WORDS!
Yeees. Only words can help you hereeeeeeeeeeeeeeee.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: Ok.
Your first challenge will be to fetch me my goblets. Yes, my GOBLETS! The goblets that I love oh so much.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: No... I don't really want to.
But... but you must.

first.name: Hubert
first.text: No, seriously, I-
If you want to get back home you have to do the challenges and learn a great lesson and-

first.name: Hubert
first.text: No, I just want to fix the sink. Just point the way, Mr. Gnome and I’ll leave.
We're NOT GNOMES!
You know, what- fine.
If you don't want to complete my challenge, I'll just have to teach you your lesson MYSELF!
